prompt:
Use case: infographic-diagram
Asset type: build-critical raster illustration for the right-hand process board in a desktop website first viewport; an isolated reusable equipment schematic
Input images: Image 1 is the approved composition and style reference only. Preserve its clean technical line-art role, vertically stacked equipment journey, restrained industrial character, and approximate three-quarter equipment viewpoints. Do not copy any text, numbers, logos, labels, brands, UI frame, page layout, or background from Image 1.
Primary request: Create one coherent illustrative customization-process schematic for pipe-inspection equipment, arranged as a visual journey through three clearly separated stacked horizontal stages.
Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background with clean alpha. No floor, room, factory, scenery, border, stage boxes, or card chrome.
Subject: Upper stage: a generic open control monitor/console and a cylindrical pipe-inspection camera head connected by a cable; the screen is completely blank and the controls are generic. Middle stage: a push-rod cable reel on a simple wheeled frame, with neatly coiled cable and mechanically plausible connectors. Lower stage: a closed rugged transport case, entirely unbranded and blank. All four equipment elements must be fully visible and uncropped. A single continuous cable-like process path guides the eye from the upper components through the reel toward the lower case without implying that the case is electrically connected.
Style/medium: precise product-design technical line illustration, raster output with crisp vector-like ink, consistent fine stroke weight, clean three-quarter isometric construction, moderate believable mechanical detail, sparse restrained hatching, mostly outlines, no photoreal rendering, no heavy fills, no cast shadows.
Composition/framing: approximately 5:4 landscape canvas. Use three stacked tiers with generous whitespace: monitor and camera across the upper third, reel dominant in the center third, transport case anchoring the lower third. Let the cable/process path form a calm S-curve across all three tiers. Keep balanced safe margins and no outer frame.
Color palette: charcoal line work #252525; restrained brick-red #8b3a2f only on small connector joints and a few short cable/process-path accents; optional very pale neutral gray for minimal internal shading; no other colors.
Text: none.
Constraints: no words, letters, numbers, labels, logos, model names, customer marks, factory marks, certifications, commercial claims, serial plates, branded silhouettes, watermarks, signatures, people, factory background, photography, UI controls, arrows, or decorative icons. It must read as an illustrative customization-process schematic, not a product photograph.
